newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Dina Q3 loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Dina Q3 loss narrows.

text.p: Mexican truckmaker Consorcio G Grupo Dina S.A. reported a net loss during the third quarter of 22.9 million pesos compared with a 157.4 million peso loss during the year-ago quarter.
The company said in a statement that its third quarter loss amounted to 0.09 pesos per share versus 0.61 pesos per share during the third quarter of 1995.

The company said its third quarter sales were 1.037 billion pesos versus 798.6 million pesos during the year-ago period. It said sales from its U.S. unit Motor Coach Industries International Inc accounted for 79 percent of third quarter sales.

Dina's gross operating margin was 19 percent of sales compared with 14.8 percent during the same period last year. Its operating profit was 29.4 million compared with an operating loss of 90 million pesos last year.
"The increase in operating profit is due to a strict cost control program that reduced cost of sales by 39 percent during the third quarter versus the same period last year," the company said.
